rationale: CRISPRa (dCas9-VP64) library of 1,979 guides against 120 transcription factors plus 120 non-targeting guides in primary human CD8 T cells from three donors, sorted into CCR7-low and CCR7-high bins. Column names (Low_D1..High_D3) match the GSM titles CRISPRa-TF-CCR7-Low/High-D1..D3. Counts are the deposited GSE241933_CRISPRa.TF.CCR7.counts.table.csv.gz with the guide sequence column replaced by the gene name (guide name without its _N suffix). Each donor gives one low and one high sort, so donor is a pairing term (2 residual df). A positive coefficient means activation raises CCR7 (memory-like); the paper's BATF3 is expected on the CCR7-high side if it promotes memory features. Library totals; the CRISPRa library is small and focused, so composition is checked in run_info.json.
